notes.title: Little Harvest Update #2
notes.content:
[b]Leaderboards[/b] have been added to the menu

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44258904/bd2e8e390b8df8cfa5327365469354aef1fca47f.png[/img]

Compare your records with your friends!

notes.title: Little Harvest Update #1
notes.content:
You can now sell multiple buildings at once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44258904/655d2093b0397e3d46db2befa6218672278f1706.png[/img]

There's a new button in the bottom right corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44258904/fe8375058b4ef782a4e0bb6b19cce8f474b1caca.gif[/img]

Click the new button, click on multiple buildings, and then click the checkbox at the bottom. 

You can sell multiple buildings at once.

notes.title: Buf fix update #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44258904/522a6aa81051b7e8e328dc7e38600789726bc929.png[/img]

Fixed problem about [b]Expand All[/b] achievement.

[b]Expand All[/b] achievement should now work correctly.

If you have already expanded all of your lands, restart the game after the update and the achievement will be unlocked.
